tenant.notes: Delaware LLC, authorized to do business in Utah. Director of Operations is primary contact.

landlord.notes: Utah LLC; landlord broker handled in-house.

property.premises_address: 4280 West Indiana Avenue, West Valley City, UT 84120
property.notes: Single-tenant cold-storage warehouse on approx. 6.1 acres; whole-building lease. Cooler/freezer, NH3 refrigeration plant, 32 dock doors, rail spur.

lease.permitted_use: Refrigerated/frozen warehousing, cross-docking, blast-freezing, ambient warehousing, repack, customer-pick logistics, and ancillary office, in support of 3PL operations.
lease.notes: Base Rent abated Dec 1, 2026 - Mar 31, 2027. ~2.5% annual escalation ($14.50 -> $18.10 per RSF). Security is a $641,625 irrevocable standby LC (no cash deposit), subject to burn-down per Section 2.7. Starting full-rate base rent shown (annual).

renewal_options.notes: Notice window: not earlier than 18 months and not later than 15 months before the then-current Expiration Date. Conditions: no default; tenant (or Permitted Transferee) in occupancy of >=90% of Premises.
Second consecutive 5-year option at Fair Market Rent; same notice window and conditions as option 1.
